sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.7051 of 2021 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C.-1, Bhubaneswar, arising out of Shree Lingaraj P.S. Case No.337 of 2021 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 419/420/465/468/471/120-B/34 of I.P.C.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel that in the meantime preliminary charge sheet has been filed in the case at hand against one of the co- accused Rohit Kumar Mahanta.

4. It is further submitted that the allegation against the Petitioner is that he had played an active role in persuading the Informant that on depositing the amount as demanded by the co- accused Rohit Kumar Mahanta, he can get an employment.
5. It is stated that the Petitioner has received only Rs.2000/-.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail in view of the ongoing investigation.

7. Taking into account the nature of allegation qua the Petitioner and the punishment prescribed,
this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner Suraj Laguri vs State Of Odisha ....
